summary:
Organizations cannot execute on business initiatives without a successful team — and D&A teams are no exception. Effective CDAOs recognize the importance of attracting the right talent and providing enticing opportunities to retain a top-notch team.

Hosted by Mark Peterson at North Yorkshire Council, come together with peers to discuss:

Offering creative opportunities and projects to lure D&A talent
Reevaluating the skills needed to successfully execute on D&A initiatives
Building a robust pipeline in a rapidly-evolving digital ecosystem

Join these Peer Meetups, powered by Gartner CDAO Communities, for a networking session that allows you to connect and share with a small group of your peers facilitated by a CDAO Community Member. Please make every effort to attend as other attendees will be looking forward to meeting with you.
